title: The Most Secure Prison in America Isn't High Security

lines.text: This is ADX Florence, America's most secure prison.
lines.vo: This is A.D.X. Florence, America's most secure prison.

lines.text: So it must be rated high security, right?
lines.vo: So it must be rated high security, right?

lines.text: And about 90 percent of the people inside weren't sent there for their crime.
lines.vo: And about 90 percent of the people inside weren't sent there for their crime.
